description: Hexagonal paving: flat-topped hexagonal prisms on a hex lattice filling a rectangle (tiles whose centre lies inside), with gaps and random height and tint. Pivot at the centre of the base. Piece: hex_tiles (paving). Every tile is a closed prism.

hex_pts.note: flat-topped hex lattice: columns 1.5 r apart, rows sqrt(3) r apart, odd columns shifted half a row

params.code: const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (!m) return; const k = haspointattrib(0, 'tint') ? point(0, 'tint', primpoints(0, @primnum)[0]) || 1 : 1; @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, k);
